topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's focus on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen recognition and innate receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the innate immune system senses microbial threats and tissue damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor signaling pathways.

topics.label: Cellular inflammatory response, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the downstream cellular events of inflammation, from sentinel cell activation and leukocyte extravasation into tissues to systemic inflammatory consequences.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory containment
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the physiological mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation, repairing injured tissue, and containing persistent pathology through chronic responses.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: It closes the lecture and announces the topic for the subsequent session.
